name: Côte d'Ivoire

fees.name: e-Visa (pre-enrolled biometric visa, collected at Abidjan airport)
fees.applies: all (entry via Félix Houphouët-Boigny International Airport, Abidjan only)
fees.notes: EUR 70 dossier fee + EUR 3 online payment commission. SNEDAI is the official government-mandated operator; snedai.com/e-visa is the only official portal. Pre-authorisation emailed, biometric visa issued on arrival at Abidjan airport.

fees.name: Biometric sticker visa (embassy-issued, short stay 1-3 months)
fees.applies: all (fee varies by embassy: EUR 50 excl. bank fees in France, EUR 58 in the UK, CAD 100 in Canada)
fees.notes: Fee paid online (snedai.com or ci-embassyepay.org depending on mission) before the enrollment appointment. Amount is set per embassy/currency rather than by nationality. Diplomatic and service passport holders are exempt.

fees.name: Biometric sticker visa - business (same fee schedule as short-stay)
fees.notes: Embassies list business, tourism, family visit and study under the same biometric visa fee (EUR 58 at London embassy, EUR 50 at Paris embassy). Long-stay visa at the Canada embassy is CAD 200.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: No separately published transit visa fee found on official sources; transit travellers use the standard e-visa (EUR 73) or embassy biometric visa. Airside transit without entry does not require a visa.

vfs.note: Côte d'Ivoire does not use VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS. Visa processing is outsourced to SNEDAI (official government partner); its handling fee is bundled into the published visa fee (e.g. EUR 70 + EUR 3 payment fee for the e-visa).

free_visa_notes: Not free in general. Nationals of ECOWAS member states (and some bilateral-agreement countries) enter visa-free. Diplomatic/service passport holders are exempt from the visa fee.
